title: Stash tag search drops name matches without aliases
evidence: The issue supplies a compact executable SQL reproduction of the generated findTags query. The OR filter lost matching names without aliases because the inner join removed those tags before either predicate ran. The merged fix converts joins in both OR branches to left joins and adds regression coverage.
source_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT tags.id FROM tags
INNER JOIN tag_aliases ON tag_aliases.tag_id = tags.id
WHERE (tags.name LIKE '%Ahegao%') OR ((tag_aliases.alias LIKE '%Ahegao%'))
adaptation: The literal is the issue reporter's runnable reproduction. The local replay removes DISTINCT and uses fixtures with at most one alias per tag, so row multiplicity from DISTINCT is irrelevant. The logged application query also had bound parameters and SQLite collation-specific sorting.
before_sql: SELECT tags.id FROM tags INNER JOIN tag_aliases ON tag_aliases.tag_id = tags.id WHERE tags.name LIKE '%Ahegao%' OR tag_aliases.alias LIKE '%Ahegao%'
after_sql: SELECT tags.id FROM tags LEFT JOIN tag_aliases ON tag_aliases.tag_id = tags.id WHERE tags.name LIKE '%Ahegao%' OR tag_aliases.alias LIKE '%Ahegao%'
